description: Lists public builders on Vibe Coding Builders, the builder with the newest launch first. one_step_ahead_of gives the builders whose latest project is one stage after the given stage, for example launching for building.

one_step_ahead_of.description: A stage. Returns builders whose latest project is at the next stage.

query.description: Words to find. A builder matches when each word is in their username, name, expertise, or the tools of their projects (a tool name as typed, such as Claude Code, or its group, such as Claude).

name: search_builders
title: Search VCB builders
